hostVersusFontTables.note: Tables read in Node from the bundled TTFs, with FreeType's documented rounding of the scaled ascender (up) and descender (down) to whole pixels and the host's whole-pixel font size.

rawTables.note: The plain table scale, without that rounding: the proposed ±1 px does not hold for the natural line height.

hostedCI.note: The native-text-layout step of .github/workflows/contracts.yml has not run on a hosted runner; nothing here claims a green hosted run.

limitations: Local macOS arm64 evidence, headless; the example also with the native renderer. Hosted CI and other targets are separate.
The tolerance is against the bundled fonts' tables at weight 400; other weights are not compared for capHeight and xHeight.

No iOS simulator or Android emulator reference was measured; the platform divergences (truncated last line, empty text, lineHeight centring condition, lines beyond a fixed height, Android's baseline field) are documented, not normative.
Open: the original Text.js, span press and selection, font loading and fallback, bidi/emoji/grapheme clusters, textDecoration/fontStyle, head and middle ellipsis, font scaling, inline views.
